notes: Kiambatisho 1 (President by constituency, PDF pages 35-38), 2 (House, pages 39-47) and 3 (councillors, pages 48-60). The pages are rotated two-page spreads; printed pages that the scan repeats were read from the complete copy.
The House annex prints each candidate's votes and the constituency's total; the councillor annex prints only the candidates' votes. Both mark the candidate declared elected (Amechaguliwa).
President: Bumbwini and Donge print the ballots cast in the registered column, so the constituencies' registered voters add to 348,035 against the 348,934 of the national line.
House: Matemwe prints a total of 6,797 for votes adding to 5,797, Kwahani 5,582 for 5,472, and Mlandege 5,279 for 5,276; the district lines agree with the candidates' votes.

Councillors: at Mtoni the CCM candidate (1,666) is marked elected although the CUF candidate has 1,945; Wesha carries no mark. The jimbo printed over Nungwi and Potoa wards, Potoa, is not a House constituency, so those wards hang under their district.
